recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional FHIR-38938 source change is needed; do not reapply the reverted PR 2428 wording separately from the later FHIR-39383 application.
issue_request: FHIR-38938 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-I change request asking for the Bundle Scope and Usage section to refer to subscriptions as well.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by commit 60f784e443f25a21fc42d11f3c25d36b38e04e4d from PR 2428, which added a Subscription event-notification bullet to source/bundle/bundle-introduction.xml. That application was then intentionally reverted by ca382932ed22370f6c1e1b09828401c0bb7ea3a5 because FHIR-39247 determined the addition was not a technical correction and should be considered through a separate FHIR-I tracker.
additional_context: FHIR-39383 was the separate Published/Persuasive FHIR-I tracker for the same Bundle-scope addition. Commit fe4c4fe1242611e593f1a440932b5d7507095129 added the current Subscription notification bullet, and c7dcf913cb74012ada27eded2894b416e59e9957 followed with an editorial typo/link-text adjustment. Bundle is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and the Bundle IG also includes the subscription-notification-bundle profile, so the checked source is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes record the votes for both FHIR-38938 and FHIR-39383; targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Bundle Scope and Usage source already includes a Subscription event-notification bullet that satisfies FHIR-38938 when the later FHIR-39247 and FHIR-39383 decisions are considered together.
